note: 2022-04-02: Frontier oracle exploit (~$15.6M); INV price manipulation via TWAP attack. Larger of the two 2022 issuer-damaging events.

label: Frontier oracle exploit, ~10.13M DOLA borrowed, ~5.83M DOLA net loss
note: 2022-06-16: Second Frontier oracle-manipulation exploit. BlockSec reports 10,133,949 DOLA borrowed (https://blocksec.com/blog/our-take-on-the-inverse-finance-security-incident-price-manipulation-attack). Inverse's July 13 proposal reports a net 5.83M DOLA loss (https://forum.inverse.finance/t/reopen-frontier/133). Cointelegraph reports ~$1.26M in attacker proceeds after the flash loan was repaid, a different quantity from protocol loss (https://cointelegraph.com/news/inverse-finance-exploited-again-for-1-2m-in-flashloan-oracle-attack). Sources read 2026-10-17.
